AboutPage.title: About Application
AboutPage.tagline: STAR TREK Heroes Search - convenient search for characters of the universe Star Trek
AboutPage.aboutAppText1: This application allows you to search for characters from the Star Trek universe using the STAPI (Star Trek API). You can browse through characters, search by name, and view detailed information about each character including their species, organizations, and status.
AboutPage.aboutAppText2: The app features real-time search, pagination, and saves your last search query for convenience.
AboutPage.developerDesc: This application was developed as a learning project to demonstrate modern React development practices including:
AboutPage.rsSchoolDesc1: This project was created as part of the RS School React Course, a free community-based educational program run by The Rolling Scopes developer community since 2013.
AboutPage.rsSchoolDesc2: The course provides intensive training in React development with a focus on practical, real-world skills. Students learn modern React concepts including hooks, context, routing, state management, and testing.
AboutPage.learnMore: Learn more about RS School React Course
